meta.title: Frequency Converter — Convert Hertz and More
meta.description: Free frequency converter for 6+ units including Hertz, Kilohertz, Megahertz. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Hertz, kilohertz, megahertz, gigahertz. Fast, accurate conversions with engineering-grade precision for everyday and professional use. Convert between 6 frequency units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for frequency in this tool is **Hz**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most frequency conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Hertz | Hz |
| Kilohertz | kHz |
| Megahertz | MHz |
| Gigahertz | GHz |
| Terahertz | THz |
| Revolutions/min | rpm |
content.use_cases:
- Photography exposure planning across lumen and lux references.
- Workspace lighting design to meet ergonomic targets.
- Display brightness and ambient-light comparisons.
- Plant-grow lighting setups.
- Stage and event lighting design.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this frequency converter?
**A:** It uses 6 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Hertz (Hz), Kilohertz (kHz), Megahertz (MHz), Gigahertz (GHz), Terahertz (THz), Revolutions/min (rpm).
